steps.content: [Enter Flashback]

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: The Sillage Society's influence reaches far and wide, but I doubt everyone in its ranks truly subscribes to the Underground's Mania doctrine. These days, faith alone isn't enough to rally that many followers.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: If they insist on invoking the name of a god... then that "god" must be nothing more than a vessel onto which anyone can project their own ideology. When everyone has their own agenda, factions are bound to emerge... and with them, weak points and cracks. This attack couldn't have come at a better time.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Treat this as an opportunity, Chief. Cast a wide net around the Ring Research Institute. You'll certainly catch something. Then we pick the most promising target to go after.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Who knows? This might be the breakthrough we've been looking for.
[Exit Flashback]

After cross-referencing multiple sources, you narrow down your list of suspects. You eventually "invite" a few of the most suitable subjects for an interview, like this businessman sitting before you.

Daniel Horston, heir to Horston Trading. He's been riding on his family's coattails to secure raw material procurement contracts with the Ring Research Institute. Among the names on your suspect list, he seems like the easiest to crack.
The conversation has been going on for 78 minutes now, and the atmosphere is slightly less than friendly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've reviewed the accounts. You had a piece of every major raw material procurement contract the Ring Research Institute gave out over the past few years. They were worth a fortune. But recently, when funding shifted to the Observation Hub, your contracts were the first to get cut.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's a significant loss. Did the Institute offer you any explanation? Did anyone give you another way to recoup the lost sum? Deliver a message for someone? Help certain parties handle some "trouble" they couldn't deal with themselves?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I imagine those major contracts were all personally approved by Isomer, the Director. You visited her recently at a seminar, right? Is there any special relationship between you two?

steps.speaker: Daniel
steps.content: I don't know what you're talking about. Without evidence, you're only making up stories.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Then let's talk about other things you know.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The 9th Agency, the Public Security Bureau, and the Regulatory Office jointly reviewed your financial records for the past four quarters. Your procurement lists, payment records, and shipping documents. We have everything.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That batch of "special metal components" you supplied to Nirvana. The group's warehouse records show that less than half was actually received. Yet the payment receipt indicates full payment. So where did the rest go?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And then there's that shipment of Hypercube purification agent. The customs declaration says it was going to a satellite town, but who was the receiver? This is a regulated material. So why don't you explain how, shortly after, similar products showed up on Fraser's black market?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're quick to doctor the books, but the system's too vast and there are too many interconnected records. It's virtually impossible to keep everything consistent, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Daniel
steps.content: I... look, when you run a business, you hit rough patches sometimes. We just needed to increase our revenue by shuffling some things around... I had no bad intentions! I'll fix the paperwork and settle the outstanding payments. That should do it, right? Don't blow this out of proportion!

steps.speaker: Daniel
steps.content: I don't know anything. From this point forward, I'm not saying another word. Talk to my lawyer. I can wait this out.
He's still defensive, but his eyes are darting everywhere, avoiding your gaze.
Honestly, compared to the Sinners you've interrogated, his defenses seem paper-thin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I won't need to. I'm sure your lawyer and my friends will have plenty to discuss.
As you say this, you pull out your phone and play a voicemail.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Do as you see fit. I'll back you up on this.
The voice of the Speaker of the City Council is unmistakable. Daniel immediately straightens in his seat, his eyes darting toward the door as it's abruptly pushed open.
9th Agency operatives and senior sheriffs gradually fill the room. Someone refills your cups. Someone else leans against the doorframe, leafing through a file. No one speaks or looks at him.

People involved with the Sillage Society seem to place an almost superstitious faith in their so-called "connections." Knowing certain people boosts their confidence, but the moment an opponent brings out a few powerful figures, that confidence evaporates instantly.
It's time. You rise and circle around behind him, placing a hand on his shoulder. You feel him tense for an instant.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know you're not just waiting for your lawyer. You're also counting on a few <color=#fb9259>special friends</color>.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you waiting for this?
You hand over the "evidence." The poor man takes one look, and his eyes go wide.
[View Image] Death Incense

steps.speaker: Option
options: This was found in your basement.

steps.speaker: Daniel
steps.content: This... How could you... Did you have a search warrant? What about my privacy... I... I don't know anything...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The security of BR-003 is the top priority. Mania threats must be eliminated. The MBCC has special authorization for all related operations. Search warrants and lawyers are irrelevant at this point.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As for those friends of yours... I don't know how influential they might be. Perhaps they're capable of protecting you. Or perhaps...
You lean down, moving close to his ear.

steps.speaker: Option
options: They'll take this opportunity to cut you loose and save themselves?

steps.content: Daniel shudders.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ha, it's just a guess. You certainly know your pals better than I do, Mr. Horston. You know how they treat their "friends."
Having said that, you straighten back up and give his shoulder a pat, smiling.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I believe you have no ill intent. You only want to inherit the family business, help it flourish, and earn your place in the family. You were simply deceived and exploited by certain dangerous individuals in the Sillage Society.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In a situation like this, the sooner you come clean and distance yourself from them, the better. A competent businessman like yourself should be able to do the math.
One last gentle pat, and his body sags under the impact.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's fine if you don't want to talk. I have other "guests" waiting for me anyway. Let me go check on them. Take your time.
The moment you turn to leave, Daniel Horston finally grabs your sleeve. His lips are drained of color, trembling so hard he can't form words. And that's how you know...
It worked.
[Black Screen] Style 14

Daniel Horston inherited his family's ties to the Sillage Society. His involvement has largely been limited to networking and pursuing business opportunities. He has benefited from the arrangement and, from time to time, carried out assignments on the Society's behalf—smuggling goods, gathering intelligence, silencing troublesome individuals, and the like. He has even botched some of these relatively minor tasks. As a result, he has never earned the chance to discuss further collaboration with Isomer, nor has he even met the Sillage Society's inner circle.

In his eyes, the organization is little more than an exclusive club with an air of mystery, a place to make money and build connections. Strange incidents happen from time to time, certainly, but this is the age of Mania. A few oddities here and there hardly seem worth dwelling on.

The Sillage Society's members are extremely cautious and rarely meet in person. (Daniel, it seems, has never even been invited to Euphoria.) Communication happens primarily through incense burning, a method that's both safe and discreet. It also fosters the illusion of being guided and blessed by some mysterious higher power.
And just as Elvira theorized: The incense is strictly bound to its designated user. It must be lit by that individual personally in order for it to "work."
In Daniel's house. To avoid alerting the Sillage Society's informants, you change into plain clothes and bring only Schorl inside with you. The black bipyramid rests quietly in your chest pocket.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: As you ordered, the other guards are maintaining a 50-meter distance. Your entry is therefore highly risky, Chief. Please be careful.

steps.speaker: Option
options: I still have you, don't I?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even Mania has to obey some logic. This half-burned incense stick can't be stronger than you. Otherwise, the Sillage Society would've already obliterated DisCity. Why would they still be operating in the shadows?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just stay alert. From this point on, radio silence. Don't let them spot you.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Understood. I appreciate your recognition.
...Didn't that sound a little smug?

Daniel, meanwhile, is far from relaxed. He leads you into a special room, closes the door, locks it, and pulls every curtain shut. Darkness swallows the space, as though he's completing some kind of ritual.

Finally, with trembling hands, he lights a candle. In the vast room, this single flame is the only source of light. Still shaking, he produces that broken half of an incense stick and brings it close to the candle's flame.
Before he lights it, he turns back to look at you. His eyes are desperate, almost pleading.

steps.speaker: Daniel
steps.content: ...You'll protect me, won't you?
He can't see the shackles you're gripping lightly, but he can see the steady resolve in your eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm watching. I won't let anything harm you.

Reassured, he turns back around. He takes a deep breath and lights the incense tremulously. A wisp of smoke rises, winding and spreading like a living thing. The candle's flame dims gradually until it goes out entirely.

Your eyes adjust to the darkness quickly. Then you see it clearly—around the smoke, a dark purple mist hovers, faint at first. Slowly, it grows thicker, expanding and creeping into every corner of the room.
[Sillage CG Flashback]
That's right. It's <color=#fb9259>her</color> scent, laced with ominous Mania, seeping into your mind.

The boundaries of space seem to writhe and dissolve, as if the darkness is reconnecting to her domain. In a daze, through the mist, you hear a drifting, somber voice and glimpse overlapping, shifting figures that seem so unsettling.

steps.speaker: Drifting Voice
steps.content: Through chaos wanders the lamb, blindfolded and bowed. Mired in dust and mud, it knows nothing of the stars above, for it never raises its gaze...

steps.speaker: Drifting Voice
steps.content: The exalted one stands upon the dais, staff in hand. Through silent nights of contemplation and beyond the veil of mist, he shall see with clarity, and he shall guide the way...

steps.speaker: Drifting Voice
steps.content: Bow before the abyss, chosen one, and confess unto chaos. Thereafter, <color=#fb9259>she</color> shall guide you; <color=#fb9259>she</color> shall favor you... Sillage shall lead you through the narrow gate, and death shall ferry you into eternal life...
As if it can smell the two of you, the smoke moves and coils around Daniel slowly, then winds its way to you. The scent grows stronger. The voices draw closer.

steps.speaker: Drifting Voice
steps.content: You lit the incense. You, too... were chosen, guided, and rewarded...

steps.speaker: Drifting Voice
steps.content: ...Why, then, do you betray <color=#fb9259>her</color>?

At the accusation, the fragrance coiling around you both constricts violently. A suffocating grip closes around your throat. In the corners, the drifting purple smoke gathers suddenly, writhing and condensing into familiar Puppets of the Underground. They lunge straight at you.

steps.speaker: Daniel
steps.content: Ahhh!!!

steps.speaker: Drifting Voice
steps.content: You glimpsed the truth. Why return to ignorance? You were granted power. Why accept cowardice?!

You yank him behind you. In the same instant, Schorl leaps out of your pocket. Together with the shackles you unleash, it blocks the first two waves of assault. Then, bullets shatter the windows from outside, and alarms blare.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: The combat unit will soon breach the area. Chief, prepare to engage the enemy.

steps.speaker: Drifting Voice
steps.content: Heh heh heh... Bound by your petty morals and blinded by ignorance... you think you can judge us? You dare challenge us? Then suffer the curse of death!
